description: Anino International Plc manufactures and markets a range of nutritional supplements and pharmaceutical products in Nigeria. The company specialises in nutritional products and supplements as well as intravenous solutions.

Capital Oil Plc is a petroleum marketing company operating in the downstream sector of the oil and gas industry in Nigeria. The company sources and supplies a wide range of petroleum products including industrial supplies, automotive gas oil, premium motor spirit, dual purpose kerosene, liquefied petroleum gas bottling, lubricants and chemicals. Capoil imports automotive gas oil in commercial quantity for the industrial and retail sector. The company has a 14-metric ton LPG plant in Ogun state in Nigeria and a 10-metric ton LPG in the Ogun state. Capital Oil Plc was rescued from near collapse in 2012 and has gone through a major turnaround exercise; profitability was restored and value to shareholders was restored. The company has 11 service outlets which were reactivated and are profitable. Capital Oil Plc’s head office is in Lagos, Nigeria.

Eterna Plc operates within the dynamic oil and gas industry, a crucial sector for Nigeria’s economy. The company’s strategic location in Lagos, a major commercial hub, positions it at the heart of regional energy markets.

IHS Towers Plc is a telecommunication infrastructure service provider in Nigeria. It is one of the largest independently-owned telecommunication tower operators in the world. The company is involved in network construction, network operations and maintenance and colocation services. Colocation and lease agreement services is the addition of new customers to an existing tower; new site services is constructing towers for customers to expand their telecommunication networks; buy-lease-back is buying a mobile network operator’s tower and related assets and leasing space back to them; managed services include managing maintenance, security and power supply for towers owned by third parties; and inbuilding solutions is the use of a Distributed Antenna System to connect large buildings and offices to a telecommunication tower. IHS Towers Plc operates in Nigeria, Sudan, Ghana and the United Arab Emirates. The company subsidiaries include Power and Communication Technology Limited (PCT), Infra

Juli Plc markets a range of pharmaceutical products to the wholesale and retail sectors in Nigeria. The company also owns and operates is own supermarkets and trading stores. Juli Pharmacy Plc originally marketed international pharmaceutical brands but diversified its positioning to produce its own brands of products. The company’s head office is in Lagos, Nigeria.

11 Plc is the sole authorised distributor of Exxon Mobil fuel and lubricant brands in Nigeria. Formerly known as Mobil Oil Nigeria Plc, 11Plc produces and markets a range of petrochemicals which includes gasoline, motor oils, lubricants, marine fuel and jet fuel. The is one of 6 major petroleum product marketers in Nigeria and operates through over 250 retail outlets located in all 36 states in Nigeria. 11 Plc has a Lube Blending Plant with a capacity of 450 000 barrels per annum. It is regarded as one of the most sophisticated lube blending plants in Africa. The company dates back to 1907 when Socony Vacuum Oil Company sold Sunflower Kerosene. Its name changed to Mobil Oil Nigeria limited in 1951 and Mobil Oil Nigeria Plc in 1978. NIPCO Investment Company acquired a 60% stake in the business in 2016 and changed the name to 11 Plc (pronounced Double One Plc).

Nigerian Aviation Handling Company PLC (NAHCO), also known as nahco aviance, is a premier service provider in the West African aviation sector. From its headquarters at Murtala Muhammed International Airport in Lagos, the Group delivers a comprehensive suite of essential services including aircraft, cargo, and passenger handling. Beyond core airport operations, NAHCO has diversified its portfolio into crew transportation, energy and power distribution, and the leasing of ground handling equipment.
Nascon Allied Industries Plc operates within the Food Processing and Manufacturing Industry, specifically focusing on essential household and industrial products in Nigeria.

NCR (Nigeria) PLC is a technology company that specializes in offering innovative solutions to facilitate seamless interactions between businesses and their customers. Established in 1949 and listed on the Nigerian Stock Exchange in 1979, the company has a rich history of technological innovation, including the introduction of the first ATM in Nigeria in 1989. As a subsidiary of NCR Corporation, a global leader in consumer transaction technologies, NCR (Nigeria) PLC is committed to transforming everyday transactions into exceptional experiences. The company’s product portfolio includes Automated Teller Machines (ATMs), retail Point of Sale (POS) terminals, and self-service kiosks, designed to empower businesses across various sectors. Headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria, with a strong presence in 180 countries, NCR (Nigeria) PLC is dedicated to making life easier through its cutting-edge technology and services .

Oando PLC is a leading African integrated energy solutions provider, headquartered at The Wings Complex, Ozumba Mbadiwe Avenue, Victoria Island, Lagos. The company operates across the oil and gas value chain, offering strategic investments in exploration, production, trading, and infrastructure development. With a presence in Nigeria, Dubai, Bermuda, and Canada, Oando has established itself as a significant player in the upstream and trading segments of the energy sector.
Omatek Ventures Plc operates within the technology and engineering sectors, primarily as a holding company with diversified interests across several subsidiaries.

Core Business Activities: STACO INSURANCE PLC (the “Company”) is principally engaged in the underwriting of Non-life insurance business. The wider Staco Group (the “Group”) offers both non-life and life insurance services, which cut across Nigeria’s public and private sectors, including Oil and Gas, Engineering/Construction, Manufacturing, Trade, Aviation, and Marine. The Company aims to strengthen service delivery through modern Information Technology techniques and expanding its branch and agency network, alongside intensifying direct and indirect marketing activities. The Group had previously set up a subsidiary, Staco Sierra Leone, which provided life and non-life insurance cover in Sierra Leone, West Africa, but this subsidiary was disposed of during the year ended 31 December 2020.
